prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png, preserving its exact layout, object positions, sizes, outlines, gaps, and openings. Output ONE transparent PNG, 1536x2048 (3:4). Inputs: paint_mask_guide.png is the edit target and absolute geometry authority; design_reference.png is the approved material/detail reference; icon_x8.png is the original colour reference (magenta is background).
The guide is three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and 3-4 repeat the same five orthographic views: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Keep all ten silhouettes exactly where they are. Do not enlarge the thin bands or clasps, move or redesign anything. Paint only existing grey pixels.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour of a belt of gold-green overlapping dragon scales, gold quatrefoil clasp with four round green gems around a gold boss. Follow reference facets, engravings, scrollwork, inner swirls, scaled and confined to each view's existing geometry. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights or reflections.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure categorical colours only: #FF0000 every metal part including gold; #00FF00 every leather/hide/fur part; #0000FF every cloth/hair part; #000000 every gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid through glass. Every silhouette pixel exactly one of these colours, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. Classify the golden scale surfaces consistently with the reference and use black for green gemstones.
Transparent background and all openings including ring interiors fully transparent. Empty column 3 of rows 2 and 4 stays transparent. No ground, text, outline, halo, sparkles or aura. Preserve guide geometry over decorative reference silhouette.
CORRECTION: Match the original guide alpha silhouettes precisely. Absolutely no stray pixels around the bands or inside either ring. Clean transparent openings. The gold front clasp must have FOUR GREEN ROUND GEMS around a gold boss, painted within the existing clasp surface. Do not omit gemstones. Bottom mask counterparts of those gemstones are pure black. Golden metal scales are pure red in the material masks. Keep all surfaces unlit without bright highlights. Reproduce the original guide positions and thin band widths exactly.
